**What will work:**
- Use an auto-reframe tool that follows the speaker, such as CapCut "Auto Reframe", Adobe Premiere "Auto Reframe", DaVinci Resolve "Smart Reframe" or Descript. Set it to 9:16 and it will keep whoever is talking centred. Turn captions off. Your 10 seconds and the original audio stay as they are.
- If you want to do it by hand, use two 9:16 crops: one centred on the man while he asks the question, and one centred on the woman from the moment she starts to answer. Keep the original audio track under both.
